## Author checklist
<!-- Tick every box BEFORE asking for review. If a box doesn't apply, write N/A next to it. -->
- [ ] PR title follows our format, e.g. `feat(header): add theme toggle button`
- [ ] Matches Figma at 375, 768 and 1440.
- [ ] Works in light AND dark mode
- [ ] No sideways scrolling anywhere between 320px and 1600px
- [ ] Hover, focus and error states are built where Figma shows them
- [ ] Only design tokens for colours, spacing and fonts (no hex codes)
- [ ] BEM class names, semantic HTML, alt text on images, labels on inputs
- [ ] No errors in the browser console, and no leftover console.log
- [ ] Tested with Live Server
- [ ] I only changed files that belong to my section

## Reviewer checklist
<!-- Reviewers: tick these as you go. -->
- [ ] I ran this branch on my own computer
- [ ] I compared it to Figma in light and dark mode
- [ ] I resized the browser and checked for breakage
- [ ] The PR only touches files from its own section
- [ ] My comments are specific and kind
